Package com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity

package com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity
Player, enemy, projectile, pickup, and visual-effect entities.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Asteroid
    A single asteroid that travels left and can bounce vertically.
    Bullet
    A single bullet fired by the player.
    EliteEnemyShip
    A faster, more precise enemy type: only fires when it's actually lined up with the player (no random pot-shots), but reloads quicker and closes the distance faster than a grunt — a sharper, more deliberate threat rather than a spray-and-pray one.
    EnemySpaceship
    Shared behavior for every enemy ship type: flies straight from right to left and decides each frame whether to fire at the player.
    Explosion
    A short-lived radial particle burst used when asteroids collide.
    GruntEnemyShip
    The basic enemy type.
    PlayerSpaceship
    The player-controlled ship.
    PowerUp
    A pickup that drifts left across the screen, same as asteroids.
    Spaceship
    Abstract base for anything that flies around on screen as a "ship" — shared position, size, image, and bounding box.
    Star
    Represents a small background star that moves from right to left * across the game screen.
